subject: Sequoya Systems: co-sell + marketplace demo — runbook & timezone stitch

Cc: AWS Partner Team <aws-partner@amazon.com>, Anita Rao <anita@cloudstride.com>
Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sequoya + Redwood co-sell demo — preferred windows and agenda

Thanks for the intro — excited to get a joint demo scheduled. A couple of constraints on our side:
- Primary presenter (CTO) available only between 13:00–16:00 PST Wed/Thu next week.
- We have customers in APAC joining; prefer the earliest slot that still catches US west coast.

Agenda we propose (30–40m):
1) 5m intros + partnership positioning (Anita/AWS intro)
2) 20m live demo (Redwood hosted API + marketplace listing flow)
3) 10m questions + next steps (mutual action plan + PoC checklist)

Attached is a quick draft runbook and SOW stub for sequencing. Can you propose two slots and who will lead which section?

Thanks,
Akira
Head of Platform Partnerships | Sequoya Systems

Subject: Re: Sequoya + Redwood co-sell demo — preferred windows and agenda

Akira — thanks for the runbook. We can take point on the live demo (Karthik will do the walkthrough) and Marcus will cover the marketplace listing & handoff steps after the demo.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Wed 2027-06-30 13:30–14:10 PT
- Thu 2027-07-01 14:00–14:40 PT

If either fits for Sequoya + AWS, I’ll send invites and a draft MAP (mutual action plan). I attached a lightweight runbook with presenter callouts and a suggested recording/backfill plan.

- Hosted API quickstart (2–3 min): latency/cost notes
